The '''''Shining Pathway''''' was a [[cathedral ship]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]] of [[Speciesism|anti-alien]] [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]] by the Republic, which was under the sway of the [[Pius Dea]] religion at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. The name of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] continued to evoke dread in the residents of the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] it had imprisoned, long after the end of the Pius Dea Era.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Shining Pathway'' was created for the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
